name: Abris Capital Partners
decision_note: Warsaw-based mid-market private equity (control investments, EUR 30-75m equity tickets); a real, active investor but not VC, so outside the cz-vc pilot.

analyst_notes: Quick S1 dossier. Strategy page states EU-11 focus on Poland and Romania, control investments in mature businesses, sectors healthcare, circular economy, digital and technology, e-commerce and modern logistics, specialist manufacturing (mapped to the closed sector list). Latest dated activity found: add-on acquisition by portfolio company Dental Holding (2026-01-20) and the sale of Czech-linked AURES Holdings / AAA Auto (signed 2025-12-12).
